# Storyboard: photoreal-song

Written before any animation. One row per stretch of the song. Read the lyric column top to bottom with the sound off: the story should still come through.

| Time | On screen | What the moment is for | How it leaves | What carries into the next shot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00.0–0:02.0 | Lyric: “God remembered Noe”. A dusk sky drifts right; the line rises into the lower third word by word | God turns toward the one he saved: warmth after the flood | The sky slows and the colour drains to grey on the last word | The horizontal drift of the sky |
| 0:02.0–0:04.0 | Lyric: “and every beast”. A pale field with the line centred | Widening the remembrance to every creature | Hard cut to black at the end | Nothing (end of test) |
